Bottom line

Midjourney still produces the most consistently striking images in this category, and the pace of model upgrades keeps it ahead on raw quality. The cost is workflow friction — prompting through Discord (or its newer web app) takes longer to learn than typing into a chat box, and there's no free tier to try before you buy.

Frequently asked questions

Does Midjourney have a free trial?

No, Midjourney currently requires a paid subscription starting at $10/mo.

Do I need Discord to use Midjourney?

Discord was the original interface; a web app is also available, but many workflows still reference Discord commands.

Can I use Midjourney images commercially?

Yes, commercial usage rights are included on paid plans — check current terms for specifics.

How does Midjourney compare to DALL·E 3?

Midjourney generally produces more stylized, higher-fidelity images; DALL·E 3 is easier to prompt in plain language.

Is Midjourney good for beginners?

It has a steeper learning curve than DALL·E 3, but the community and documentation help a lot.

When was Midjourney last tested by Luvent?

We last tested it on 2026-06-15.
